outcome.technical: Verified jest/pytest semantics against current upstream docs (raw jest Configuration.md, pytest reference.rst via curl; context7 not available). Findings: jest docs name micromatch not picomatch (docstring fixed); current jest default testMatch extension is ?([mc])[jt]s?(x), version-dependent, so default-config answers for .mjs/.cjs/.mts/.cts are now COULD_NOT_TELL (case j5b); pytest python_files default and testpaths-only-without-args confirmed. Added jest --listTests and pytest --collect-only -q listers (LISTERS table, collects asks the runner's lister); pytest list only proves COLLECTED, never refutes. Neither binary is installed here, so those readers are exercised via injected listers and fake shell-script binaries, not real runs (stated in the docstring). Updated sc11/sc13 in test__output.py (listed in files), the guide paragraph, and switched __main__ to selftest_requested (sfl8 lint). Results: test__runner_collects 94/94, test__deps 307/307, test__output 225/225, ruff clean. plugins/audit/README.md left as is for the commit. Full sweep/vermin whole-tree not run.
